notes.title: The Visual Update is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors,

Your Halloween candy has arrived early. Hellbreach: Vegas is flashier, prettier, and scarier than ever. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43190635/f283212ac15755569882ce577250bd71c1b1ccaa.png
The Visual Update is OUT NOW!

I’ve already given you a little sneak preview of the updated slots, perk machines, and the terrifyingly refreshing new demon designs in last week’s blog. Now, you can finally dive into the new visuals yourselves.

Here’s a list of the changes that you can expect once you boot up Hellbreach: 

Upgraded Slot Machine Design: I revamped the slot machines with a more polished look and style that better fits the Vegas theme.

Reworked Perks System: Perks can now be bought at a vending machine rather than from perk cards, providing a more cohesive and immersive experience.

Polished Maps: I enhanced the maps where necessary, with improved models, textures, and overall layout refinements.

Improved Lighting: The lighting has been improved across all maps for better atmosphere and visibility.

Reworked Textures: All textures, including those for enemies, weapons, and environmental assets have been reworked.

Updated Player Select Screen: I’ve revised the player selection interface for some additional polish.

Enhanced Map and Enemy Visibility: The overall visibility of maps and enemies has been improved to make enemy visuals clearer and more distinguishable.

Improved Enemy Damage and Death VFX: I implemented upgraded visual effects for enemy damage and deaths to make them more impactful.

Smoothing of Enemy and Weapon Animations: Enemy and weapon animations are now smoother to improve fluidity in combat.

Overall Optimization for Stable Frame Rates: I’ve enhanced performance across the board to achieve stable frame rates across various setups.
I’m really happy with how this update turned out and I can’t wait to see everybody’s reactions. 

If updated visuals sound enticing to you and you haven’t had the chance to pick up Hellbreach yet, the game will be 33% off during Steam’ Scream Fest. If you want to go for a test drive, the Hellbreach Demo has also been updated with the new visuals!

Now go play those freshly painted slots, will you?

Ash

notes.title: The First Look: Hellbreach: Vegas Visual Update
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors,

A week has passed since the last blog and, as promised, I’m here to share a first look at the Hellbreach: Vegas Visual Update that we’ve been cooking up!

As mentioned in the previous blog, we’ll be rolling out a visual overhaul of perks, slot machines, and our favourite slaying targets: demons! So, let’s get into some of these changes:

Slot machines

The slot machines will maintain their trusty, one-armed bandit look - but with a fresh coat of paint. Perk cards can now be bought using soda vending machines that you can find spread out across the map. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43190635/587387d301b3b7f90b9a0238b8c53b5b243a37e8.png

I felt like redesigning the machines was a necessary step after some of your feedback made it clear they needed more polish and character to really match the "Vegas" vibe. The goal was to give them that flashy, over-the-top look while keeping the dark tone of the game. 

Enemies

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43190635/2c004922f2f2dd4870bf779aaa42d2055cc1c891.png

Along with the machines, the demons will also be getting a visual upgrade! With better textures and improved visibility, you’ll still recognise their ugly mugs. But I added a hellish glow and more detail that’ll make them stand out better in the game, and make it more satisfying for you to watch them go POP!

That’s all I want to show you for now! I’m really excited to consistently get to work on making Hellbreach fit my vision even closer and I’m glad that I have your feedback to guide me!

What do you think of these changes? Are you looking forward to the visual update?

Ash

 Steam Deck Scaling Filter: FSR
Graphics:

 Resolution quality: 85% (slightly below 100%)
 Shadow Quality: Medium
 Anti-Aliasing: High
 Visual Effects: Low
 Ambient Occlusion: 100%
 Reflection Quality: 10%
 Motion Blur: Off
 Depth of Field: Off
 Bloom: Off
 NIS: None

Display:

 Fullscreen: Off
 Brightness: 40%
 Max Frame Rate: Unlimited
 Vsync: On
 FOV: 95
 Resolution: 1152x720

Feel free to try out these settings and let us know in the comments or on Discord if you still run into performance issues.

notes.title: Hellbreach: Vegas - Build ‘1.0.1.’ Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Dear survivors,

First of all, I want to thank you all for your incredible support during the 1.0 launch of Hellbreach: Vegas. Seeing the full version of the game after months of refining was incredibly satisfying and I can’t begin to express how thankful I am for the community. 

I’ve spent hours watching your content and reading your reviews and I figured it was time to introduce the very first post-launch patch, addressing some of your most urgent concerns. Here’s a detailed breakdown of what we’re addressing in this patch:

Patch Notes:

 Steam overlay bug fixed
 Localisation issues fixed
 Jump animation fixed
 Boost machine will always result in a win
 Portals stay closed longer (when shot)
 “Leave game?” confirmation screen added to menu
 Win A Weapon drops are now bound to the player that played the slots: You can share them with another player through melee
 You can no longer steal other players’ drops such as boosts and points, ensuring fair play
 Added Nightmare to scoreboards for improved competition
 Improved visibility for player outlines through walls
 Added visual marker for downed players 
 Fixed high FPS visual stutter
 Motion blur now disabled by default
 Reduced effects on motion blur when enabled
 Resolved issue where NVIDIA NIS caused pixelated graphics for some players 
 Game will now default to full-screen native resolution on start-up

TL;DR: Quality of life improvements including performance and fair play.

That’s it for this patch! More updates, focussing on long-term improvements for the game, will follow in the future! Thank you again for your support and if you have any extra input, please join the Discord and let me know!

See you,

The Hellbreach team

notes.title: Major Update: Get Ready To Storm In, Area 51 Is Ready For You!
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors,

It’s only been a month, but we’re back in action! Development is going steady and we’re preparing for the final sprint towards 1.0. I hope you’ve enjoyed the new game mode and the map from last month’s update – I’m still open to more feedback.

I also hope that you’ve explored it sufficiently, because a brand new map is ready for you… and it’s a big one!

Nevada’s not only home to Sin City, it’s also a sprawling hub for flying saucers, little grey men, and secret government research facilities. Phase 4 takes us to top secret territory with a new weapon, new outfit, new accessories and of course a new map (including several new [strike]Easter Eggs[/strike] anomalies that are out there for you to find).

Curious what Phase 4 brings? Check out the trailer here: 
[previewyoutube=bZLF4ykAxv4;full][/previewyoutube]

This concludes Phase 3 of Hellbreach Vegas’ Early Access timeline. We’re now going into Phase 4, the final phase before full launch! 

Aside from the new additions as can be seen in the trailer and the patch notes I’ve also incorporated valuable community feedback.

The game now includes a crouch functionality and visual markers to show you where you got hit. Additionally, we’re updating the demo tomorrow (28th of June) to better reflect the current version of the game, to make it easier for you to convince your friends to come and play a couple rounds!

We’re also proud to inform you that all AI placeholder art has been removed from the game and replaced with paid art from real artists.

Again, for a more detailed breakdown, please check the patch notes here.

Get ready to dive in, survivors, the patch is now live!

The Hellbreach Team

notes.title: Spiritual successor to Left 4 Dead gets massive new update and demo
notes.notes:
Remember Left 4 Dead? So does everyone else, quite fondly, and yet nothing's really managed to bring it back to the forefront, even spiritually. Back 4 Blood was a sorely mismanaged attempt, and all we've had otherwise has been Call of Duty's Zombies modes. Thankfully, this could change with Hellbreach: Vegas, a solo-developed zombie -  sorry, demon - survival shooter that's just received a huge update and a free demo, all while standing at an impressive 83% positive reviews despite being in Early Access. Referred to as 'the end of Phase 1' by its developer, Infinity Ape Studios, this update brings in several additions to refine the demon-slaying experience.
Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Early Access: Build ‘0.1.2’ Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors,


You thought we were done improving the game for this week? Hell no!

This time we bring you some essential adjustments requested by you on our Discord. We greatly value your feedback, and the best way for us to show it is by implementing it! 

Patch notes:

 Major improvements for reducing "Head Bobbing": The character-camera animations have been smoothed out, significantly reducing "Head Bobbing".
 The turning sway animations for the guns (when you move from left to right) have been smoothed.
 A new setting has been added in the controls "Toggle Aim Head Bob". Turning it off completely removes "Head Bobbing".
 A new setting has been added in the controls "Toggle Weapon Sway". Turning it off removes Weapon Sway.
 Server improvement: The animations of demons were smoothed server-side. The previous code was out of date with the upgrade to Unreal Engine 4.27, causing demons to stutter in certain instances when playing online.
 Replaced various pieces of AI placeholder art with open source alternatives.
 An issue with the Directional Audio during Multiplayer games has been fixed.

For anyone still encountering the infamous black screen issue please remove the HellbreachVegas folder in C:\Users\%username%\AppData\Local.

TL;DR:
Improved movement animations including head bobbing, less AI art, and more server improvements!

What’s next?

The next thing on the agenda is fixing the frametime issue that is especially prevalent on NASA-grade hardware and causes massive lag spikes. This is likely related to higher than expected vram usage for specific cards. (If you are encountering this problem and want to help resolve it please join the Discord and share your hardware specifications).

See you in the streets of Vegas!

notes.title: Early-Access: Launch Patch
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors,

With a launch, comes a first big update!

I prepared these patch notes for you to give you an overview of the major fixes I've done between the last playtest, and the EA launch.

- Refilling ammo now applies to all missing clips, meaning that players can refill all their weapons at once
- The cost of reloading now depends on which weapons require additional clips
- The boost machine's upgrades now apply to all weapons the player is carrying; before it only applied to the weapon the player was holding at the time of picking up the boost
- Gun Pro has been rebalanced, easy and normal difficulty should allow for a lot more breathing room
- Fixed a minor issue in the party system where party members would occupy the same slot in the party resulting in visual bugs
- DLSS now auto-detects your device's capabilities and will offer you only relevant options
- Fixed a number of locations where demons would get stuck
- Buffed glass reflectivity; they are more sparkly now, which should hopefully help prevent players from running into glass-surfaces
- Fixed several localisation issues
- Opened up the front desk in the casino map so that players can attempt a last stand setup
- Added redistributables to the build to ensure proper installation on brand new machines

I can't wait to hear what you think of the game!

See you in the streets of Vegas!

The Hellbreach Team
